_note: ANIMATED armour sets whose colour is a live animation frame, NOT a dye. While worn they cycle through a fixed, published list of hex frames, so EVERY observed colour is just a frame — never a real exotic. A piece whose item-id matches a pattern here is excluded from exotic detection entirely (tagged 'animated', dropped like random-dyed). If `frames` is non-empty we also defensively exclude those exact hexes on ANY item (covers mis-typed ids). Hex lowercase, no '#'. Source: Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki (Great Spook Armor colour cycle).
